text:
ana_cs: Quick heads up — customer Katie (Org KAT-77) in the preview reports two users can"t log in after the IdP cert rotation. They"re mid-eval and worried about rollout impact. Can SRE triage and we"ll offer a quick enablement?

lee_sre: On it. Do we know if they use group-based provisioning or invite emails?

ana_cs: They use SCIM + group mapping. Katie said only users in `devs` group are failing.

ops-bot: incident 1708889999 created: label=beta-onboard sso-outage severity=medium

lee_sre: Running `auth-check --org KAT-77 --group devs` now. If mapping empty, we can re-sync group claims as a workaround.

tom_enable: I can do a 15m enablement demo and resend invites after the fix. Available tomorrow 9:30am PT. Will include a 2-question feedback form.

katie_cust: 9:30am PT works. Appreciate the quick help. We"re nervous about the contract renewal if seats stay down.

lee_sre: Found cause: IdP sent `memberOf` as string list key `groups` but our matcher expected `groupNames`. Pushing a small transformation patch now. ETA 30m.

ops-bot: deploy 1708890050: patch/sso-claim-transform deployed to prod-canary

lee_sre: Patch live; requeued SCIM sync for KAT-77. `scripts/scim-sync --org KAT-77 --force` returned: 3 users activated, 2 re-invites sent.

ana_cs: Sent customer note with next steps and scheduled tomorrows demo invite. Included link to feedback form.

katie_cust: Invites arrived, two users back online. Thanks team — see you at the demo.

tom_enable: Great. I"ll run the 15m session and capture feedback + a short enablement checklist for our playbook.

ana_cs: Action items: 1) lee_sre: add claim transform to our SSO onboarding doc; 2) tom_enable: run demo 9:30am PT + collect feedback; 3) ana_cs: update CRM renewal risk tag and paste feedback. Close loop after demo.
